links.comparator_used: AI-only advice in a skin cancer app, with no teledermatologist supervision
links.outcome: Patient trust in the advice (0-100 scale) and adherence intention (3-level ordinal), measured in an online vignette experiment
links.effect: Trust was higher for hybrid advice than AI-only (mean 76.9 vs 65.7; estimated difference 11.98; partial η²=0.22; P<.001). Odds of adherence were 1.7 times greater with hybrid vs AI-only (OR 1/0.59=1.7, 95% CI 1.28-2.22; P<.001). The effect on adherence was fully mediated by trust.
links.quote: Teledermatologist supervision of AI-based advice robustly increased patient trust and adherence intentions, particularly for high-risk assessments and concerned users.
